rules.statement: The right to claim specific performance of an agreement to sell immovable property is excluded by the terms of the contract, particularly by clause 8 which constitutes a substituted obligation and the sole obligation upon the vendors in the event of failure to secure conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is only in the absence of agreement to the contrary that the Roman-Dutch law confers on a purchaser under an executory contract the right to select one of two alternative legal remedies under the Roman-Dutch law, namely, specific performance or damages. But we have here a categorical stipulation that if the primary obligation is not fulfilled for any reason whatsoever, two specified sums shall immediately become due."
